hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json)$'; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env'; then echo 'Blocked: never edit .env files directly. Tell the user what to add instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf (/|~)|supabase db reset --linked|eas submit|DROP TABLE'; then echo 'Blocked by project safety hook.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); if [ "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; npx tsc --noEmit >/tmp/tsc-out 2>&1 || { echo 'TypeScript errors remain — fix before finishing:' >&2; head -30 /tmp/tsc-out >&2; exit 2; }
